user.title: Browser session
user.description: Sign in at myaccount.uw.co.uk, open your browser's developer tools, copy the `Cookie:` request header for that site, and paste it here. The session lasts about a month. Password sign-in is not supported: the portal requires a browser check that Home Assistant cannot complete.

data_description.user_agent: Only needed if requests are blocked by Cloudflare. Paste navigator.userAgent from the same browser you copied the cookies from.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh the Utility Warehouse session
reauth_confirm.description: The saved browser session for {account} has expired. Sign in again at myaccount.uw.co.uk and paste a fresh `Cookie:` header.

data_description.user_agent: Only needed if requests are blocked by Cloudflare. Paste navigator.userAgent from the same browser.

error.auth_error: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials.
error.connection_error: Could not connect to Utility Warehouse. Check your internet connection.

abort.reauth_successful: The Utility Warehouse session was updated.

init.title: Update the Utility Warehouse session
init.description: Sign in at myaccount.uw.co.uk, open the developer tools, copy the whole `Cookie:` request header for that site, and paste it here.

data_description.user_agent: Only needed if requests are blocked by Cloudflare. Paste navigator.userAgent from the same browser.

error.auth_error: That cookie header was rejected. Copy the full `Cookie:` request header while signed in.
error.connection_error: Could not connect to Utility Warehouse. Check your internet connection.
